summary: In this Ramadan daily tafseer episode, Sheikh Ali Mashhour reflects on the concept of divine wisdom in not fulfilling all our desires. He explains that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) does not comply with every whim of those around him, which is actually a blessing from Allah. The sheikh emphasizes that we often don't know what is truly good or bad for us, making Allah's refusal to grant every request a form of mercy. He further discusses how Allah beautifies faith in the hearts of the guided, making them love what Allah loves and hate what Allah hates, describing such people as enlightened and strong in their guidance. The episode concludes by noting that these blessings are purely from Allah's grace and wisdom, as He is all-knowing about who deserves such traits and all-wise in distributing them among His servants.
suggested_title: The Blessing of Divine Wisdom: Why Allah Doesn't Grant Every Request
